search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail encryptionType 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "errorCode" nodrop 
| where isBlank(errorCode) and eventSource="redshift.amazonaws.com" and eventName="ModifyCluster" 
| json "responseElements.pendingModifiedValues.encryptionType" as encrypted 
| if((encrypted matches "NONE"),1,0) as disableEncryptionEvent 
| sum(disableEncryptionEvent) as count 
| count as count 
| "Redshift_DisableEncryption" as benchmarkname 
| "EventCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("Redshift_DisableEncryption") in benchmarkname, values("EventCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
